note: Teams capture scope (integrations/capture_teams; directive 8f6976e58be5 item 10; owner directive "Teams everything", 2026-10-21). Which conversations: every channel of every team the census enumerates and the people guard clears (teams all_census_cleared: not only the teams a member joined), and the chats of every account in scope of operating/case_mail_scope.json (plain words: since 2026-10-26 that is every directory user except the excluded people, because that file sets all_directory enabled; the exclusion filter runs before any chat is requested, and if the exclusion list is missing nothing is read) (member_chats mail_allowlist: chats are decided, devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-07-ovs-teams-capture.md item 2, owner policy e251073ef3c5/746d96497341). Content of that set is read once the census lists it and the people guard clears it; there is no human confirmation step (owner decision 2026-10-26). The member cos@ (joined_teams) is the member-joined baseline the census is compared with, and what TeamsCapture.run, which takes no census, still reads. Those chat accounts are read from the allowlist on every run, never listed here: a change to the allowlist changes whose chats are read. A member named here must be on the same allowlist, or it is set aside before anything is requested. This file grants nothing: the capture principal still needs the live-source audience, and every reader is re-gated per conversation and per message on the membership captured with it. Named chats (chats): the chat the case briefs and maps were attached to (devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-27-case-originals-served.md, Unblock). The CLI reads a named chat only once its census cleared it (its members read, the people guard first); this chat is listed through its members' chats. TeamsCapture.run, without a census, reads it directly. Its first content read, 2026-10-28, was that run for this chat alone (39 messages, 8 members).

census.note: Census (TeamsCapture.census; directives cdce67ac8e8c, 64fca27acc88): every team and channel of the tenant and the chats of the chat accounts, names and 30-day counts only, read once the people guard cleared their members. max_chats is the largest cap (2026-10-27: the tenant's chat accounts hold about 4,600 chats, most of them meeting chats; a cap of 200 kept the census on the same first 200 chat ids forever). A census the cap or its time budget cuts starts the next one after the last chat it reached (capture_teams.CENSUS_CHAT_CURSOR), so every chat is reached in turn. The keywords below propose a channel or chat to Tanush by its name, for purchasing, QA and R&D; a proposal, never a grant. Content is read of everything the census lists that the people guard cleared; there is no human confirmation step (owner decision 2026-10-26).
